public static int findNthLeapYear(int Y, int N) {
    int count = 0;
    int year = Y;
    while (true) {
        if ((year % 4 == 0 && year % 100 != 0) || (year % 400 == 0)) {
            count++;
            if (count == N) {
                return year;
            }
        }
        year++;
    }
}
